name: What is the typical timeline for a residential construction project managed by professionals?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a residential construction project managed by professionals?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a residential construction project is highly dependent on its scope, from minor renovations to custom home builds. A small remodel might take a few weeks, while a major addition could extend to several months. New custom home construction typically ranges from 10-18 months, not including design and permitting phases. A professional project manager develops a detailed schedule, accounting for material lead times, subcontractor availability, inspections, and potential weather delays to provide a realistic completion estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary greatly; small remodels take weeks, large additions months, and new custom homes typically 10-18 months, with professional management providing realistic estimates.
